2.49.17
List.ZIndex
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The List.ZIndex element specifies the ZIndex of a List. This element is optional. If this element is
present, its value MUST be an UnsignedInt. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as
0.
Following is the parent element of the List.ZIndex element.
Parent elements
List
The following is the XML Schema definition of the List.ZIndex element.
 <xsd:element name="ZIndex" type="xsd:unsignedInt" minOccurs="0" />
